summary: A Dubai luxury real estate company appears to lose investors to a free builder address, a two item menu and no listings or WhatsApp.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a Wix banner on the page, though your email uses vista-properties.com.
findings.cost: Investors spending millions look for a serious company, and a builder address looks temporary.
findings.fix: Your own domain connected to the site.

findings.problem: The menu appears to have only Home and Blog, and I did not see individual property listings.
findings.cost: Investors come to see properties, and a page with long text and no listings sends them to the big portals.
findings.fix: Listing pages with photos, prices and filters.

findings.problem: The homepage appears to be a long text page about the company and neighbourhoods.
findings.cost: Visitors skim, and a wall of text hides the reasons to call you.
findings.fix: Short sections, proof and a clear call to action.

findings.problem: A phone number is shown, but no WhatsApp appears.
findings.cost: Overseas investors message first, and the agent who replies first gets the call.
findings.fix: A one tap WhatsApp button and an enquiry form.
